in_sanskrit.name: मनस्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
मनस् (mind)
Manas is the Sanskrit word for mind. It is derived from the root man, meaning 'to think'. In Hindu philosophy, manas is the fifth of the five sheaths or koshas that cover the Atman or soul.

in_hindi.name: मनोज
in_hindi.long_meaning:
मनोज (mind, intellect)
Manoj is a common name in the Hindi language. It is derived from the Sanskrit word manas, which means 'mind'. The name Manoj signifies a person who is intelligent, wise, and thoughtful.
